_notes: Two clients. Replace kite.example.in with your KITE_HOSTNAME in your own copy, never in this file.
The CF Access service-token values are NOT written here: both blocks read them from the environment (CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID, CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET). See deploy/README.md.
Claude Code is the supported client for orders: it connects to /mcp directly with the two headers, and its permissions.ask rules make every order call ask first.
Claude Code permissions (.claude/settings.json): {"permissions": {"ask": ["mcp__kite__place_order", "mcp__kite__cancel_order", "mcp__kite__modify_order"]}}. Never put an order tool under allow.
modify_order is excluded on the server (EXCLUDED_TOOLS), so it does not appear; the ask rule stays in case it is ever re-enabled.

Claude Desktop through mcp-remote: READ-ONLY use (login, get_profile, get_margins, get_positions, get_orders) until you have checked that place_order and cancel_order show an approval card on every call. Claude's docs describe per-tool 'Needs approval' for connectors, not for local servers in claude_desktop_config.json. Never click 'Always allow' on an order tool.
Write CF-Access-Client-Id:${...} with no space after the colon: Claude Desktop on Windows does not escape spaces inside args.

env.CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID: type it here, in your local copy only
env.CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET: type it here, in your local copy only
